_comment: Slipstream (tow) + dirty air. WAKE MODEL (card, round 8): every car leaves a trail of its recent path (a point every trail.stepM, with its speed then; plain sim state). A follower near a leader's trail gets WAKE = ALONG x SIDEWAYS x SPEED RATIO: ALONG = 1 up to trail.fullCars car lengths bumper to bumper behind, fading to 0 at trail.lengthCars (overlapping, it fades to 0 fully alongside); SIDEWAYS = 1 within trail.sideFullWidths car widths of the trail, 0 at trail.sideZeroWidths; SPEED RATIO = min(1, the leader's speed at that point / the follower's speed). Several cars ahead: the strongest WAKE. TOW: drag x (1 - tow.maxDragReduction x WAKE). DIRTY AIR: downforce x (1 - dirtyAir.maxDownforceLoss x WAKE), everywhere (no cornering gate). No tyre-wear multiplier: wear comes only from the physics. trail.enabled false = the old straight-back wake, kept only for comparison (tow minRangeM..maxRangeM inside wakeWidthCars x car width widening by wakeWiden, heading within maxAngleDeg; dirty air within dirtyRangeM). aiTowEagerness: how keenly AI difficulty presets tuck in behind a car on a straight (0 = never). wind / wake: client feedback (sound when tucked in, faint VFX streaks on high).
